notes.title: Mighty Knight Legacy celebrates Game Devs of Color Expo!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We are proud to be selected as part of Game Devs of Color Expo this year! 
Be sure to wishlist Mighty Knight Legacy if it sparks joy! 
Also, don't forget to checkout other cool games created by awesome devs of color!

- FIREBEAST TEAM -
